RecordsApprovalPoliciesLayout.title: Approval policies
RecordsApprovalPoliciesLayout.description: Decide when generated documents need internal approval before they go out.

ApprovalPoliciesBrowser.title: Approval policies
ApprovalPoliciesBrowser.emptyBody: Policies route generated quotes, proposals, order forms, and contracts for internal approval — by document type, total value, or discount depth — before they can be finalized.

ApprovalPolicyDialog.description: Documents matching this policy must be approved before they can be finalized.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.currencyRequired: A currency is required when a total threshold is set.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.thresholdHint: With no thresholds, every matching document requires approval. With thresholds, approval is required when any one is reached. Totals only compare within the policy's currency — add one policy per quoted currency.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.chainHint: Leave the chain empty to require a single approval from anyone who can approve documents.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.chainEmptyHint: No steps: one approval from anyone who can approve documents.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.noEligibleApprovers: No workspace members are available to name as approvers.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.quorumTooHigh: This step asks for more approvals than it has approvers.
